title.en: Order 100 / 125 mm Pipe Only from the Xingtai Pages That Print It
title.zh: 只有印了 100 / 125 mm 的邢台页面，才按这个管径下单

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints 100 / 125 mm on the electric mixer, HBT8018, HBT80-16 and LZ-60. Electric 15 prints 100–125 mm. Other trailer pages used here leave pipe diameter blank.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把 100 / 125 mm 印在电动搅拌泵、HBT8018、HBT80-16 和 LZ-60 上。电动15印 100–125 mm。此处使用的其他拖泵页把管径留空。

h1.en: Match an Existing Pipe to a Page That States the Diameter
h1.zh: 把已有管子对照到写明管径的页面

directAnswer.en: If you already have 100 mm or 125 mm pipe, Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai does not treat every pump as a match. The lists used here print 100 / 125 mm on the integrated mixer, HBT8018, HBT80-16 and LZ-60. Electric 15 prints 100–125 mm with a hyphen, on a 450 kg page. Electric 20 prints 80 mm instead. Electric 30, Electric 40, Electric 80, Diesel 30 and Diesel 60 do not print a delivery-pipe diameter. Send the diameter you have and the path that prints a diameter, to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/). Do not fill a blank page. No price is printed.
directAnswer.zh: 如果你已经有 100 mm 或 125 mm 的管子，河北品锦机械（邢台）不会把每台泵都当成匹配。此处使用的列表在搅拌泵一体机、HBT8018、HBT80-16 和 LZ-60 上印 100 / 125 mm。电动15用连字符印 100–125 mm，那是 450 kg 的页面。电动20印的是 80 mm。电动30、电动40、电动80、柴油30和柴油60不印输送管径。把你已有的管径和印了管径的路径发到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。不要填空白页。没有印价格。

heading.en: Slash and hyphen are both printed
heading.zh: 斜线写法和连字符都是印出来的

body.en: 100 / 125 and 100–125 appear as the pages write them. Copy the mark from the page you order.
body.zh: 100 / 125 和 100–125 按各页的写法出现。从你订的那一页抄写符号。

heading.en: A DN200 elbow is not this cell

body.en: A spare elbow page is a parts purchase. It does not state the outlet of these pumps.
body.zh: 配件弯管页是配件采购。它不说明这些泵的出口。

body.en: Write “pipe on site” and “pipe on the page” as two figures.
body.zh: 把“现场的管子”和“页面上的管子”写成两个数字。
